title: IUVM: Iran-linked influence content network
summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Iran-origin operation "IUVM", using AI to generate and translate pro-Iran, anti-Israel and anti-US website content.
body: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Iran-origin operation "IUVM", using AI to generate and translate pro-Iran, anti-Israel and anti-US website content.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布封禁了与伊朗关联的“IUVM”网络账户。该组织利用AI技术生成并翻译大量具有政治倾向的虚假内容，试图在社交媒体和网站上进行舆论操纵。这是OpenAI在打击利用AI进行恶意影响行动方面的又一例证。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI封禁了利用AI进行虚假信息传播的伊朗关联网络，体现了模型安全治理的持续行动。
